fromTsShort.name: fromTs
fromTsShort.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp >= fromTs. Default, if not specified = now minus 1 hour.

toTsShort.name: toTs
toTsShort.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp < toTs. Default, if not specified = 1 hour after fromTs.

fromTsLong.name: fromTs
fromTsLong.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp >= fromTs. Default, if not specified = first long energy entry.

toTsLong.name: toTs
toTsLong.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp < toTs. Default, if not specified = 7 days after fromTs.

fromTsModbus.name: fromTs
fromTsModbus.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp >= fromTs.

toTsModbus.name: toTs
toTsModbus.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp < toTs. Default (if not provided) = 7 days after fromTs.

filterGroup.name: filter[group]
filterGroup.description: When set to 'phases', the energy data entries will be collapsed to reflect the phases.grouping configuration of the device.

convertEnergy.name: convert[energy]
convertEnergy.description: Converts energy data to kilowatt hours or kilowatts.

fieldsEnergyPF.name: fields[energy]
fieldsEnergyPF.description: \'+pf\' will append calculated power factor to the returned energy data objects. Note that filter[group]=phases can't be combined with fields[energy]=+pf.

fieldsEnergyTimestamp.name: fields[energy]
fieldsEnergyTimestamp.description: fields[energy]=timestamp will return just the timestamp attribute in the returned data object.

fieldsEnergyPFAndTimestamp.name: fields[energy]
fieldsEnergyPFAndTimestamp.description: \`fields[energy]=+pf\` will append calculated power factor to the returned energy data objects. \`timestamp\` will return just the timestamp attribute in the returned data object. +pf and timestamp are mutually exclusive and can't be combined, i.e. fields[energy]=+pf,timestamp will result in an error. The fields[energy] query string options can't be combined with filter[group]=phases.

timezone.name: timezone
timezone.description: Required if granularity >= hour. Irrelevant (and ignored) if granularity is < hour.

items.description: Negative Real Energy value for a device channel

eRealNegative.description: Negative Real Energy values for each device channel. Over the Long Energy period there may be points of negative energy (e.g. exports to the grid) that are "hidden" in the `eReal` value for the period if the overall total is positive. `eRealNegative` enables you to determine the total negative flows during the period

items.description: Positive Real Energy value for a device channel. Over the Long Energy period there may be points of negative energy (e.g. drawing energy from the grid) that are "hidden" in the `eReal` value for the period if the overall total is negative (for example if solar generation results in an overall export for the period). `eRealPositive` enables you to determine the total positive flows during the period
